name: Blackened Alchemist
body:
You are willing to sacrifice even more for your power than others.

Prerequisite(s): Alchemist 1st.

Benefit(s): You gain the burn class feature of the kineticist, being able to accept burn in place of spending quintessence.

You can only accept an amount of burn equal to your Intelligence modifier.
